title: Unfold a laptop stand and set its highest position
instruction: Fully unfold the laptop stand and set it to its highest position. Spread the two sides to their full width, lift the upper supports, and seat both support rods securely in the base slots for the highest setting. Leave the entire stand inside the red tape rectangle, resting stably on the table. Release it and move both grippers away.
context: Setting up a portable laptop stand requires coordinated manipulation of a passive scissor linkage, raising two supports, and seating separate support rods. The task tests whether a robot can assemble a stable configuration of a familiar adjustable object.
setup: Two YAM arms, 0.61 m apart, face a 1.1 x 1.3 m oak worktop with calibrated top and wrist cameras. A 0.24 kg stand with ABS rails, silicone pads and steel pins starts folded (276 x 53 x 28 mm), centered at tabletop (0.46, 0) m. A 12 mm red tape border encloses x=[0.29,0.63], y=[-0.12,0.12] m. The stand opens to 185 mm width and has seven height slots; slot 1 is highest. No laptop is present.
scoring: Final score: 0.25 for width 180-190 mm; 0.5 adds both pins in slot 1 (|seat error x/y/z|<2.9/1.8/0.5 mm); 0.75 adds full containment in x=[0.29,0.63], y=[-0.12,0.12] m, lowest point |z|<=0.5 mm, both bases |z|<0.5 mm and tilt<2 deg. Score 1 adds contact<0.01 N, speed<0.01 m/s, spin<0.1 rad/s and joint error<0.5 mm, with all conditions held for 1 s. Otherwise 0 or the highest currently satisfied tier. Tabletop is z=0.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz (120 simulated seconds), including 32 Dream history warmup steps. Dream ends early on full success. The scripted demo completes within the same limit.
fidelity: Approximate rigid-body PhysX model: 10 bodies, 11 passive joints and 114 convex colliders; CPU TGS at 960 Hz. Hinges, sliding links and rod-slot contacts are simulated without snapping or assisted grasp constraints. Mass, inertia, friction and hinge resistance use estimates; product calibration remains pending. Pads are rigid; deformation, wear and fracture are omitted. The expert plans from measured mechanism state; Dream receives RGB and joint state only.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 after 120.0 s; scripted joint-target demo: 1.0 after 105.05 s. One fixed initial layout, seed 0.
reset_notes: Restore the stand to its folded pose at the red rectangle center and reset both arms to their ready pose. Reset elapsed time, score and the one-second stability timer; settle under gravity for 0.5 s. No consumables or randomized object placement.
